Create an internal object with admin privileges.

This command allows creating objects that may be internal or built-in instances,
including object specifications, lifecycles, templates, and other system objects.

Flags:
    --data <string>
      Inline YAML data for the object
    --dry-run
      Show what would be created without actually creating it
    --file <string>
      Path to YAML file containing object data (required)

  Create an object specification
  zqk internal create object_spec --file my_spec.yaml
  Create an internal lifecycle definition
  zqk internal create lifecycle --file lifecycle.yaml
  Create a kind synonym
  zqk internal create kind_synonym --file synonym.yaml

Usage:
  zqk internal create <kind> --file <file> [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --data string             Inline YAML data for the object
      --dry-run                 Show what would be created without actually creating it
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing object data (required)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
